title: Detent Engage — prospect cut
reader: A CRO or founder whose website takes enquiries and whose team answers them late.
reaction: We are paying for traffic and throwing away the conversations it starts.
model: What it does for them, what it will not do, and how little they have to do.

beats.small: They typed their name into a form and left.
What you got back was an email address and eleven hours of silence.

beats.lower: This asks the questions your form never does.
It prices from your own published rates. It cannot invent one.
It finds the constraint the buyer had not mentioned.
Then it books the meeting, with a named person.

beats.big:
It cannot say
what you have not approved.
beats.small: It answers only from knowledge you published. When it does not know, it says so and hands over.

beats.lower: Your visitors can talk to it, too.

beats.big:
It tells every visitor
it is AI.
beats.small: And it will not try to work out who they are until they say yes.

beats.lower: One script tag. No tag manager, no data layer.

beats.big:
An afternoon for the tag.
A week for the knowledge.
beats.small: No implementation project. No data migration. No professional services line.
The conversation your website is already having. Answered.
